description:
The most recent Total CMS release: version, title, date and the release summary.

Returns: paginated releases objects with url per item.
name: latest_release

has_more.description: True when total > offset + count(items); call again with offset += limit to paginate.

items.description: Matching releases objects, each decorated with a `url` field where the collection has a public URL pattern configured. Field set varies by collection — call describe_collection for the schema.

url.description: Public URL for this object when the collection has a URL pattern configured.

limit.description: Cap applied to this response — server may have lowered the requested limit.
